digitization_method.axis_calibration: per-panel affine least-squares fit from every actual major-tick segment parsed from the frozen SVG axis/frame element
digitization_method.curve_selection: exact filled-circle present-PIV vector objects within frozen panels; clean-source counts and canonical inventory hash required
digitization_method.error_composition: conservative L1 bound from tick-fit residual, decimal quantization and half marker width, separately for coordinate and value
digitization_method.independent_repeat_rule: two cleared deterministic PDF-to-SVG conversions with exact marker and tick inventory equality plus independent 1200/2400-dpi visual audits
digitization_method.sampling_rule: all published target marker-object centres; no densification, smoothing, symmetry fill or station interpolation
